decisions.reason: Promotion to its own page in 2024 signals that early evidence favours the single-tube condenser, so the firm should keep the option open and invest further.
This condenser variant was also promoted to a dedicated page, showing positive resolution of uncertainty, and keeping it costs little because it shares technology with B.
The tube liner is a low-cost repair add-on that fits the firm's heat exchanger expertise, and its prospects are still uncertain with only stable mentions, so keeping the option open is cheap.
Customized air coolers are built to order and cost little to keep listed, and the evidence so far does not show that their value is unlikely to be realized.
Tube end repair inserts are an inexpensive aftermarket option alongside D, and there is not yet enough negative information to justify abandoning them.
